messages:
maria_sales: Heads up — VentureQ POC is blocked. Their demo calls to /v1/generate return 403 with an org mismatch error.
sam_se: can you drop the request/response they see? headers, token prefix, anything from the gateway logs?
maria_sales: pasted what the customer logged:
```
POST /v1/generate 403 Forbidden
Authorization: Bearer svc_abc123...
X-Org-Name: venture-q-corp
X-Project-Id: demo-app
Body: { prompt: "test" }
Response: { error: "forbidden: token org claim 'venture-q' != header 'venture-q-corp'" }
```
They insist headers are correct on their side.
julio_eng: quick sanity check: svc_ prefix => service key. Service keys are normally bound to a specific org/project at mint-time. If the token's internal org claim is e.g. `venture-q` but they send `X-Org-Name: venture-q-corp`, that will trigger validation failure. Also some proxies rewrite headers (underscores/dashes, case normalization). Are they fronting with an API gateway that might mangle `X-Org-Name`?
anya_sre: yep. Also we compare canonicalized claim vs canonicalized header. If their CI/CD or corporate proxy adds a suffix or strips characters, mismatch happens. Ask them to return the raw HTTP request we received (we can provide a debug proxy URL).
sam_se: alternative quick fix for demo: either remove the extra org/project headers and let the token binding decide, or create a short-lived demo token that matches the headers they want to present. Which does VentureQ prefer?
maria_sales: they want to show multiple projects in the demo UI, so they'd prefer sending explicit headers. Are short-lived tokens easy to create?
anya_sre: yes — we can mint a demo service token scoped to `venture-q-corp / demo-app` and set it to expire in 24h. Security note: do not paste private keys in this thread. We'll generate and share a console link.
ops-bot: deploy-bot created temp key `temp-demo-472` (expires in 24h). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/demo-keys/temp-demo-472
maria_sales: perfect — forwarding that. One more question from them about trial billing: if they hit the trial cap during the demo, will calls fail or get charged?
tara_billing: Trial accounts get free credits. If credits run out, requests will return 429 / quota_exceeded; we do not auto-upgrade or charge without an explicit plan change. I'll DM customer billing FAQ and thresholds.
maria_sales: thanks. Julio — any followups we should ask the customer to validate to avoid flapping during the demo?
julio_eng: ask them to: 1) capture the exact request we receive (we can provide a temporary debug endpoint), 2) confirm token prefix (`svc_` vs `sk_`), 3) try the demo token we generated, and 4) if they need header-based routing, we'll mint a project-scoped key for each project.
anya_sre: I'll prepare a short boilerplate for the enterprise security questionnaire about token lifecycle & audit: tokens are rotatable via console/API, usage is logged to audit trails, and for Private/Dedicated customers we support KMS/HSM integrations.
maria_sales: copying that into the questionnaire now. Closing this thread once VentureQ confirms the demo key worked. :white_check_mark:
